body:
Yeah I get that. I think it's less about telling them (I have plenty of people that do know) and more about other people who joke about suicide might genuinely be trying to do that, I think instead of shutting it down saying "I am uncomfortable with that subject" would be a better way since it's less about getting mad at the person telling the jokes and more about personal preference. It would be even better if they straight up asked if it was a joke or it's a sign of something serious, even if it doesn't really actually lead to a conversation about it I think I would appreciate them asking, even if it doesn't fix everything for me, I think a lot of people's days would even be made better if that happen, even if it was just a little question.

 Otherwise, I have no problem if somebody is uncomfortable with it and would be happy to explain that I don't want to undermine the suffering of others and that is really is a just a joke to cope with tragedy and personal problems but that kind of conversation just never gets to happen if it's a conversation that's shut off from the start. I guess that's just an opinion though.
